seo.title: BoaterWise — NSBC-Certified On-Water Boating Courses on Lake Texoma
seo.description: Hands-on boat handling with NSBC-certified instructors who are also USCG captains. Four 3-hour on-water modules ($199 each, 2–4 students), private instruction on your own boat, a Boat Club course and Trailer Like a Boss — all on Lake Texoma at Lighthouse Marina.

home.heroTitle: Learn to run a boat the way captains do.
home.heroSubtitle: Small-group, hands-on training on Lake Texoma with NSBC-certified instructors who hold USCG captain's licenses. No classroom — you're at the helm from the first hour.

intro.title: Confidence is a skill. We teach it on the water.
body: BoaterWise is the training arm of the Texoma Destinations family. Our instructors are National Safe Boating Council certified and USCG captains who run charters on this lake every week — so what you learn is how boats actually behave in wind, current and a crowded marina, not how they behave in a video.

Classes run on 24-foot Berkshire pontoons from the Lighthouse Marina dock, with a maximum of four students so everyone gets real time at the helm. Complete all four NSBC modules and you earn a Certificate of Completion. Already own a boat? We'll come teach you on it.

features.title: Module 1 — Intro to Powerboating
features.body: Pre-departure checklist, centering the helm, shifting and throttle control, station holding. The foundation for everything else.

features.title: Module 2 — Precision Docking & Boat Handling
features.body: 180-degree turns in tight spaces, port and starboard docking, and the S.C.A.N. method for situational awareness around the marina.

features.title: Module 3 — Open Water Boat Handling
features.body: Trim and planing, ferrying across wind and current, emergency stops and shoreline approaches.

features.title: Module 4 — Advanced Maneuvering
features.body: Wake crossing, person-overboard recovery, sharp turns and collision avoidance. Finish here and you're certified.

features.title: Private instruction on your boat
features.body: Bring your own boat (up to 32 feet) and we'll build the session around it — docking at your slip, launching at your ramp, the maneuvers you actually worry about.

features.title: Boat Club course & Trailer Like a Boss
features.body: A two-hour orientation for Big Water Boat Club members (free with membership), and a two-hour trailering clinic that ends the ramp anxiety for good.

hubHandoff.title: Book a class, then go boating
hubHandoff.body: Classes and private instruction are scheduled online. When you're ready to put it to use, Lighthouse Marina rents the same Berkshire pontoons you trained on — and Big Water Boat Club members get free BoaterWise training plus 50% off rentals.

plan.title: Courses, schedule & where we meet
plan.subtitle: Training runs from the dock at Lighthouse Resort & Marina, 300 Lighthouse Drive, Pottsboro.

arrival.title: What to expect
body: Each NSBC module is three hours on the water with two to four students. Meet at the Lighthouse Marina fuel dock 15 minutes before your start time; we'll have the boat, life jackets and a checklist ready. Wear non-marking shoes, bring sunscreen, water and a hat.

In Texas, boater education is recommended for everyone and required for operators born on or after September 1, 1993 — the free BoatUS Foundation online course covers the classroom portion; BoaterWise is where you learn to actually drive.

directions: From Pottsboro, SH 289 north about 6 miles; Lighthouse Drive is on the left just past the Tackle Box.
Park in the resort lot and walk to the fuel dock.
Private instruction on your boat: we meet you at your marina or ramp anywhere on Lake Texoma.

faqs.a: None. Module 1 assumes you've never touched a throttle.

faqs.q: Is this the Texas boater-education certificate?
faqs.a: No — that's a free online course through the BoatUS Foundation. BoaterWise is hands-on, on-water training that builds on it.

faqs.q: Can two of us share a private session?
faqs.a: Yes; private instruction is priced per session, not per person.
Big Water Boat Club members receive free BoaterWise training, and TAP Navigator members save 10% on courses.
